rules.accepted_credit_types: Organized programs relevant to dentistry/oral health/patient care; activities developed or approved by nationally recognized organizations such as the ADA, AGD or dental specialty organizations qualify. No credit for business, marketing, finance, personal development, insurance topics.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt for the first renewal period (or portion) after the license is first issued.
rules.carryover: Up to 15 excess hours may be applied to the next renewal period; not for CPR, infection control, jurisprudence, radiography or opioid hours.
rules.alternatives: Exempt during honorable active military duty, practice in another state whose CE rules are met, government duty abroad; extensions/exemptions for disability or illness.
rules.audit_note: Number of CE hours is reported at renewal; keep evidence 4 years after renewal; Board may audit and request certificates.
rules.legal_basis: 481 Iowa Administrative Code chapter 573 (Dental Continuing Education); 481 IAC 572.17; Iowa Code ch. 153, 272C

topics.who: Iowa jurisprudence related to dentistry, dental hygiene and dental assisting
Those who regularly provide dental services to children: mandatory reporter training (Iowa Code ch. 232), within 6 months of employment, then before the certificate expires
Those who regularly provide dental services to adults: dependent adult abuse mandatory reporter training (Iowa Code ch. 235B)
Dentists who prescribed opioids to a patient during the biennium (others attest); must also read CDC opioid guideline if not covered
Current hands-on CPR; max 3 h credit (ACLS/PALS hour-for-hour)

rules.notes: Dental licenses expire August 31 of even years; CE period Sept 1 - Aug 31. Current hands-on CPR required (max 3 h credit; ACLS/PALS hour-for-hour). Self-study max 12 h. Sedation/GA permit renewal: ACLS or PALS + 6 h sedation CE (counts toward license).
